name: CHART_BRING_TO_TOP(GET)
summary: This EA is a monitoring utility that periodically checks which chart window is currently active (on top) by iterating through all open charts and reading their CHART_BRING_TO_TOP property. It prints the symbol name of the active chart to the Experts log every 3 seconds. It does not open, close, or manage any trades.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个监控工具，每3秒遍历所有打开的图表窗口，通过读取CHART_BRING_TO_TOP属性来判断当前哪个图表处于活动状态，并将活动图表的交易品种名称打印到日志中。它不执行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不包含任何交易策略，它纯粹是一个信息监控工具。其核心逻辑是在OnTimer定时器回调中，每3秒执行一次遍历，通过ChartFirst和ChartNext函数迭代所有打开的图表。对每个图表调用ChartGetInteger读取CHART_BRING_TO_TOP属性，如果返回值为true，则该图表为当前活动窗口，随后通过Print函数将图表对应的交易品种名称输出到日志。没有入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理相关的逻辑，因为它不执行任何交易操作。唯一可配置的行为是定时器间隔（硬编码为3秒）。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any trading strategy; it is purely an informational monitoring utility. Its core logic resides in the OnTimer callback, which executes every 3 seconds and iterates through all open charts using the ChartFirst and ChartNext functions. For each chart, it calls ChartGetInteger to read the CHART_BRING_TO_TOP property, and if the value is true, it identifies that chart as the currently active window and prints the associated symbol name to the Experts log via the Print function. There are no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management logic since the EA does not perform any trading operations whatsoever. The only configurable behavior is the timer interval, which is hardcoded to 3 seconds in OnInit.

parameters.name: TimerInterval
parameters.description: 定时器间隔（秒），控制检测活动图表的频率
parameters.description_en: Timer interval in seconds for active chart detection frequency

pros: 代码逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和修改
使用ChartFirst/ChartNext遍历所有图表的方法规范可靠
资源占用极低，仅做属性读取和日志打印
pros_en: Clean and straightforward code logic that is easy to understand and modify
Proper use of ChartFirst/ChartNext iteration pattern for reliable chart traversal
Extremely low resource consumption since it only reads properties and prints to log
cons: 定时器间隔硬编码为3秒，无法通过输入参数配置
仅打印日志输出，无视觉界面或声音提醒，实用性有限
while循环上限100是硬编码常量，缺乏灵活性且未处理极端情况
没有OnDeinit函数清理定时器资源
cons_en: Timer interval is hardcoded to 3 seconds with no input parameter for user configuration
Only outputs to the Experts log with no visual interface or sound alert, limiting practical usefulness
The while loop upper limit of 100 is a hardcoded constant lacking flexibility and does not handle edge cases
No OnDeinit function to clean up the timer resource
improvements: 添加输入参数让用户自定义检测间隔时间
添加OnDeinit函数调用EventKillTimer释放资源，并在图表上显示活动图表信息而非仅打印日志
improvements_en: Add an input parameter to allow users to customize the polling interval
Add OnDeinit with EventKillTimer for proper resource cleanup, and display active chart info on the chart visually instead of only printing to the log

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无财务风险
缺少OnDeinit清理定时器，可能在EA移除时留下残余定时器事件
risk_points_en: The EA performs no trading operations, posing zero financial risk
Missing OnDeinit timer cleanup may leave residual timer events when the EA is removed
